articles.title: Ukraine and Russia carry out prisoner swap after US-brokered talks
articles.summary: US-brokered talks between Ukraine and Russia concluded a second round in Abu Dhabi, aimed at resolving Europe's largest conflict since WWII. A major prisoner swap occurred, indicating some diplomatic engagement despite ongoing hostilities. These discussions highlight the complex nature of international mediation in seeking de-escalation and peace, crucial for understanding global geopolitics.

articles.title: India, US discuss ways to boost collaboration in critical, emerging defence tech
articles.summary: India and the US recently held a key meeting, focusing on strengthening collaboration in critical and emerging defence technologies. Discussions centered on meeting evolving security requirements and boosting joint development and co-production initiatives. This strategic partnership aims to advance both nations' defence capabilities, enhance interoperability, and ensure readiness for future challenges, reinforcing regional stability.

articles.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,443
articles.summary: Ukrainian forces reportedly inflicted serious damage on the Russian city of Belgorod through nighttime shelling on Friday, February 6. The region's Governor, Vyacheslav G..., confirmed the extensive damage. This incident highlights the ongoing military exchanges and their impact on civilian infrastructure, serving as a critical point for defence analysis within the wider international conflict.

articles.title: Neon releases creepy liminal trailer for Exit 8 — and I'm hoping for another great horror adaptation
articles.summary: Film distributor Neon has announced its new horror movie, 'Exit 8,' with the official trailer now released. The film is set to premiere in theaters on April 10. 'Exit 8' joins a growing slate of recent horror adaptations, such as 'Iron Lung,' highlighting ongoing trends within the entertainment industry and cultural sector.

articles.title: 5 LCA Mk1A fighter jets fully ready for delivery to IAF: HAL
articles.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has announced that five Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) Mk1A fighter jets are now fully ready for delivery to the Indian Air Force (IAF). This development marks a significant achievement in India's indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities, bolstering the IAF's operational strength with advanced, domestically produced aircraft. It highlights the nation's progress towards self-reliance in critical defence technology.
